prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A wide shot beneath two massive, parallel steel bridges stretching into the distance over a broad river, creating a dramatic sense of symmetry and depth. In the foreground, two figures stand side by side with their backs to the camera, gazing out toward the water and the vanishing point of the bridges. The figure on the left wears a dark, loose-fitting suit, while the figure on the right is dressed in baggy, utilitarian clothing with a prominent white "X" on the back, and holds a coiled rope or cable in one hand. The ground is rough and unkempt, with patches of grass and scattered debris. The entire scene is bathed in a cool, blue-toned monochrome, lending a moody, almost surreal atmosphere. The lighting is diffuse, with no harsh shadows, evoking an overcast day or early morning. The composition emphasizes the imposing structure of the bridges and the smallness of the human figures, creating a contemplative, cinematic mood reminiscent of art-house or neo-noir films.
